text: I absolutely love Arizona Pizza Company. They're our go-to sit down pizza place. The service is friendly and the pizza is delightfully cheesy.
I like to get fried chicken meals here.The shrimp is also good. But my favorite is the biscuits!!

Great Sonoran Hot Dogs for lunch (with excellent french fries) brought us back for supper the next day. Very good Carmelos (Carne Asada & Pork) and excellent Mai Tai's. The guacamole and chips were just OK. Overall a very good experience.

Good ice cream if you only want to spend the most you can. The 6 ounce small cup is not even filled up, so why not put it in a smaller cup? A Phila tradition,  ice cream for 4 (small size ) cost 26$. 
Yes I will not be returning. The bourse location is lovely and has been totally redone. Nice to see but on a Saturday it's a tourist heaven.

Was starving after 13 hours of work at the Largo Medical Center. Walked myself down to Maggie's after seeing their breakfast burrito on the menu on yelp. The staff was nice, but that's about where the good experience ended. Server took my drink order for a water and then my order for the breakfast burrito upon dropping the water off. She returned about 7-10 min later with the burrito on a plate with side cups of sour cream, pickled jalapeños, and I think some kind of taco sauce or something. The sour cream was pretty much all I used; I tried the red sauce and it tasted like cocktail sauce so I passed on it. The burrito was bland beyond compare. Nothing in it was seasoned, it was hot, but the only flavor coming out of it was the bit of flavor you get from the black beans. I was so disappointed after getting so pumped for a good breakfast burrito. It even has sausage and bacon in it, but that wasn't enough salt to enhance the flavor. I'm not sure, but the eggs may also be instant scrambled eggs; they didn't have the dense protein content you'd expect, and had literally no flavor to them. I may have told my server about this and considered trying something else, but she never came back to see how things were. After waiting about 10 min to see if she would come back, I finished my food. She came back very quickly after, still didn't ask how things were, and said simply "I'll bring you a check" without asking if I wanted anything else. Pretty sad experience, and I wish I would hav

Finally stopped in after seeing hundreds of delicious photos of their 'za on social media and Yelp. I'd also briefly met the owners before at Indy Pies & Pints and they were so friendly and enthusiastic. I love supporting people like that! Here's why The Missing Brick rocks: 

- They support other local bizs: Hank's Smoked Brisket and Chef Oya in particular by putting their items on their pizzas. Yum!

- They have a sliding window where you can order and pick up your food, making it easy and safe to stop by during COVID19.

- They have a big side patio with picnic tables and fun music (and usually fun outdoor games when social distancing isn't happening).

-  Their staff were super friendly, as was everyone who was hanging out outside.

- The Trap pizza is one-of-a-kind: crab, big chunks of shrimp and Chef Oya's Trap Buttah make it a truly great spread.

I've heard that the dough bites are delicious as well, so will try those next time. My husband got the OG Pizza and couldn't finish it because of how salty it was, so I personally would recommend going for The Trap 
 pizza! The pizzas are craft pizzas and are therefore on the pricier side, so know that, as well as the fact that it's a 21 and up pizza spot. Enjoy  and snag a cocktail for me!

This has quickly become my favorite Wawa in the city. It's pretty new and is a perfect mix of spaciousness and selection. Whereas the one at 6th and chestnut is HUGE, but perhaps a bit too vast, this one is is really the perfect size to get a nice selection of snacks and what not. It's right at 12th and market, so super convenient location for any regional rail travelers.

THIS PLACE IS A COMPLETE SCAM!! DO NOT ORDER THROUGH ANY APP.

Looks like I had the same experience as many people. I ordered through doordash. After waiting an hour and a half my dasher called and told me that the restaurant claimed my food was picked up by someone else.  I called the restaurant, they were rude and completely unhelpful. Doordash was helpful and refunded my money but at this point I have a very hungry family with no food. Probably my worst take out experience to date.

Good evening to my Yelp Family!! I have been patronizing this location for years. We stopped here because my brother wanted two quarter pounders with cheese and an apple pie. My mom also ordered her filet o-fish plain, ( no cheese, no tartar). When I arrived, the lady that waited on me, was waiting on another customer. The lady associate smiled when she saw me and asked me, May I take your order? I have heard and read many reviews saying how rude the staff is and how unprofessional the drive-thru staff are and I am happy to report that the lady associate that took my order was friendly and polite and the other staff were polite as well. I had no issues today, whatsoever with pleasantries. I stated my order and I walked away with my order in 5 minutes. My visit was short, brief and sweet. There is a staff member here who cracks me up with his comments about everything all day long. He always makes me smile!! Thank you Micky D's for a productive visit today!! Yelp Family, good night, til the next review!!
Thanks to our archnemesis Covid19 Nanas has a great deal they're calling the Virus special for $35 or 45. They feed a family of 4. Pretty standard Mexican fare and flavors.

Enjoyed our pizza. Gluten free crust was acceptable. Would not work for those with celiac since it's cooked on the same surface as other pizzas. Very friendly staff. They were up front with explaining the options!
One of our favorite sushi places in philly! Delicious food, fresh fish, friendly staff....couldn't recommend enough!

5 of us went for first time yesterday. Always wanted to try it. The beer was delicious! Dopplebock out of this world! Great IPA's too! Server was attentive and sweet! We had the pretzel and cheese dip app, the Floridan Smoked wings (omg) and the bread and cheese dip. All dynamite! I had the hugest lobster roll ever! So yummy! I could only eat a third of it as it was so big! Came with fried pickles and dip, perfect!! Hubs had excellent fish and chips! They offer habenero tarter so we tried it. Too hot for us!!! Glad we got regular tarter too! Other orders were meatloaf and shepherds pie. Everyone loved theirs! We left stuffed and happy. Bought some beer to go! Will definitely be back!

Just stopped by for a quick taco.  Great little arrangement for outside seating. Heaters to keep you warm.  Fast and attentive service.  Tacos, beans, and rice were perfect texture but need some salt. The regular salsa was flavorless and like water so I asked for the hot salsa which was 1000 times better. Have to try more items before rating higher so I plan to go back.

Best Ramen in Indy hands down! We stumbled across this place on Yelp and decided to check it out because of the solid reviews and we are so happy we did! The service is great, the food is amazing and it comes out pretty quick. We've been 3 times in the last 3 weeks and we are telling all of our friends about this hidden gem!

I love this place and highly recommend it! There aren't very many Asian food options around the area but this place is one I'll keep on my radar because it hits the spot every time. Compared to the Bay Area location, the quality of the meat is just as good but I do feel that the meat portions are just a bit smaller. The food comes out pretty fast and I like that I'm able to customize the flavor to my liking with the condiments on the table(eg. garlic shoyu, teriyaki sauce, and black pepper). Given that they are a newly opened restaurant, I understand that their customer service/servers are still in training but it is pretty solid(shoutout to Charlie! and Jason! for the excellent customer service). However, I would prefer not to be asked if I wanted water every minute or so and if they changed their cups to reusable cups to be more environmentally friendly. 

For a first timer, the menu could be overwhelming since there are so many yummy options to choose from! I'd recommend the Curry Beef Udon(!!), Curry Beef Rice with Cheese, and Garlic Beef Pepper Rice :)

Great restaurant for lunch or supper....good selection of foods and the ahi tuna sandwich was to die for with the special sauce on it.  The waiters, front desk girls and also the manager were very helpful and seriously wanted to make sure we had a good experience.  They are always busy for a reason....and worth the wait!!

I ordered two orders of crawfish that were mostly just the head of the crawfish.   I go here all the time and have  never complained.   The person that I spoke with in the phone when I called did seem to care at all that I just spent 50+ dollars at there establishment almost every week. She said that the manager will contact me in a few days.   If I could give it no stars I would.  They have went way down a hill.  I will no longer be going to this restaurant

Fantastic and authentic.  A great find in Paoli shopping center.  This place gets steady business. Food is high caliber.  They have a heat index on their menu. Pay attention to it because dishes can get quite spicy. Good quality ingredients.  Vegetables are crisp and not over cooked.  Highly recommend.  Nice space for dining in and they have a lunch specials menu.

Server was good, but the food is very generic and not worth the price, the vegetable tasted like they were steamed in the microwave, my chicken Marsala had four little pieces of mushrooms and a little sauce. Very disappointing and leads up to the fact that chain restaurants are not worth the time or money.
The food here is always above average.   The prices here are always above average.    Overall my review with three stars is above average.   Very very expensive to eat here.

Wish I knew they were "closed until further notice" before driving 40 mins here. Sick of businesses not updating their hours. 

Guess I will have to try another time... maybe..

Our group was excited to try this place out. Our first impressions were bad unfortunately.  First, we couldn't find the entrance.  The door that was facing the street said to go around to another door.  Then there was no signage on the "other door".  Somehow you're supposed to know that you have to enter an office building to get to the front door of this place.  

After that, we walk in and it was literally the loudest restaurant I've ever been in.  It was 6:30 on a Friday night, but we couldn't even talk to the hostess about a table, it was so loud. 

Not wanting to have a splitting headache after sitting across from each other without being able to talk or hear, we left and chose another restaurant.  

The menu looks cool and decor was near, but this restaurant had better fix some logistical issues pronto if they want to stay in business (better signage and sound deadening material?).

Daiwa is a superb sushi spot! It was busy the night we went, but the wait was only 20 minutes. Our servers were friendly but a bit distracted. I ordered a cocktail from the menu but they were out, which was disappointing. We ordered different types of dishes - sushi, rice bowl, grilled entree - and they came out at random times. 

Every dish was delicious. They serve unprocessed chicken nuggets (in case of kids or picky eaters). I had the half Daiwa roll and it was yummy. The sashimi appetizer was all fresh fish. (The restaurant gets twice-weekly deliveries from Japan.) 

Overall, a great experience.

Don't give me Penne and Alfredo sauce and call it Mac  and Cheese.

I ordered the 10 oz. sirloin Medium and it arrived Well done,it was very tough.One of the worst Steaks I've ever had.

Stop compensating your crappy food with Pepsi,I can see through your lies.

This is tasty.
I enjoyed a nice takeout lunch from this location. 
I used the mail flier coupon and so glad to try this new restaurant.
Next time I'll go eat in. 
I recommend this place, so many options to choose from. 
I chose the crackers in place of the bread.

Used to be my favorite place for years, however, this place has gone downhill. Their prices for their portions has been cut. You have to pay for rice even if you order an entree like mongolian beef. What, NO RICE with it! Also, the owners sister is so damn RUDE to other employees. The way she talks to some of the staff is despicable.

The food here is ok.  The customer service should be updated!  The managers don't always pay attention to the LACK OF ATTENTION BY THE SERVERS!!  You have to motion some of the servers to get refills or if you wish to add something to your order.  I use to go there more, but the lack of attention by the servers, I go elsewhere more..
Blackberry Sangria is a great way to start the day! Ordered stuffed shrimp and a Gyro.  Delicious! Our server, Will, was great. A very nice lunch experience.

Fast and friendly service and delicious food at great prices, I couldn't be happier!  My family and I enjoyed watching chef Chris prepare the food from the breakfast bar.  they even made the kids pancakes look like Mickey Mouse!  We look forward to going back soon!
The chefs here are blessed by God. The flavor and food is God level. Get the Peaches and Cream Pancake and thank me later

Great Chinese food...I am always pleased with the quality and size of portions  of the food . I usually get chicken or shrimp fried rice. The Cashew chicken "fried"is excellent. Have been going here 20 years. This business has been there 45 years now. I have tried other Chinese take out but I Yen Ching is really the best I have found in StL., an institution.

I was looking for another poke place that I could visit, so after some deliberation, I chose Pokeworks. They are a chain. I thought that the salmon bowl that I made wasn't very fresh. The fish was fishy and a little slimy. I liked how I could have half noodle and half vegetables.

Fabulous catered food! We hired Seis to make street tacos and mini Chimichangas for a large family reunion.
The Al Pastor and Pic Chuc Chicken were incredible. Wonderful flavors. Seis Sauce was an added hit!
Chimichangas were terrific. A good appetizer size. The bean chimi was especially good!
Anna, the manager at the downtown location, was helpful, accommodating, and easy to work with. 
I cannot say enough good things about the food! Wow!

(This review is from a visit in 2019.)

We loved this restaurant! Located near the corner of Howard Avenue, there was lots of good energy surrounding this place. We parked in the smallish lot across the street but had no trouble finding a space since there were many people coming and going.

Menu is tapas style, so lots to choose from
and everything was excellent ... both in taste and presentation! 

While the hostesses were a bit aloof, the server was extremely friendly and helpful.

Definitely looking forward to returning!
I come here every time I'm visiting family. Amazing food and it's consistent. Very tasty. Must try the saag paneer and kati rolls. I wish we had one of these in NYC.

A good hotel a bit past it's prime. Spacious rooms and everything you need.  The interior could use some updates - but the location is fantastic and it's easy to walk pretty much anywhere downtown. The attached mall is nice for quick food options or shopping.

Order a ackee and salt fish with food and got a platter with mashed up ackee and enough onions in it to make two whole onions and barely no salt fish full of black pepper. At least they gave me enough water in my platter of food to wash this bullshit down. As a Jamacian this was not what I was expecting, ackee food soup. ‍

Been here more times than I can count and finally decided to leave a review. Now I don't think it's 5 starts worthy only because there's nothing that's exceeds my expectations but everything about this place is good. I've always had good service here. The atmosphere is awesome. It's nice coming here to watch the games or races. All I've ever ordered were wings and in my opinion they're really good. All in all, if you haven't given this place a try then you should.

My family and I are newly vegan and still trying to traverse the change (especially my kiddos.) We were so hungry and this restaurant was on our way. Boy am I glad we stopped! I got the portobello wrap and it was too die for! My daughter got spring rolls and cried because she wanted more and my son had the kids "chicken" quesadillas and was sad that he finished it. If you are vegan or just hungry in general stop by because this place is delicious!
Great food! You get to customize your toppings, it's like the chipotle of pizza places. Friendly staff, neat atmosphere/ decor, and clean!

BEST PIZZA IN TOWN ‼‼‼

Also their wings are amazing 
 
Everything is always fresh deff try the supreme pizza

Found this place by accident browsing through Yelp and decided to drop in. I got a gyro tray and hummus. The hummus was DELICIOUS! I'm still thinking about it to this day!  A lot of hummus that I've had in the past had a slightly sour taste to it (like the store bought brand) but the one here didn't have that. The portions were sizable and the meat was flavorful ( I think I got lamb).

I went around lunch time and it seemed like a lot of the customers were take out orders. I was really impressed when we ordered, sat down and waited for our food to be called but instead, one of the staff dropped it off at our table. They're very friendly there and I don't know for sure but it seems family owned. 

Two thumbs up from me!

The place to go for a fix of fish head soup. Lots of meat mixed in a broth of hot savory soup. Try the original one with meat and fish bones, or for those with kids, with fish fillets. Both are nice to eat because of the broth. 

Their other Chinese dishes are also good. Try the beef hot plate, smelly bean curd, pork bits in sweet sauce. 

Overall you will need to box up the uneaten portions as you will tend to order lots of dishes.

If you like steak and can handle spice, get the gored gored. 

My favorite dish on their menu AND the best gored gored in Philly.

Maybe it was an off-night, being Easter Sunday, but the food was watery and not very flavorful.  We ordered aloo gobi that was watery, light on vegetables and tasted slightly of tomatoes.  I could've made it better myself.

One time going to this same exact store I got great service from a girl named gissele, we had a great convo and she made sure I got everything I needed and on top of that the food was delicious!! Shoutout to giselle  keep up the good work

First off no masks are being worn by anyone working here. 
Outside sign says the bar will not have barstools due to regulations - barstools right next to one another
Says digital menus only but they are passing out a laminated sheet 
I witnessed the bartender fill outside cups from the bar ice scooper
Now about the food - 
They got my order wrong twice and I am pretty sure since they mixed my order up with someone else they took the order I had out to the person that ordered it - I can not confirm this but I'm pretty sure. 
I ordered the mushroom and swiss with onion rings and ranch. It came out with mac and cheese. So the cook said he would bring me out onion rings. Then my waitress comes over and says they had the mix up. And the cook took my burger and the mac and cheese and gave me a burger with some half burnt onion rings. 
Not a minute later I heard the bartender say he was taking out the mac and mushroom burger out to the guest. 
My burger was advertised on the menu as having bacon - no bacon on it - had to ask for it. And 4 little mushrooms. No ranch for my onion rings and no pickle that is usually on my plate :(. 
Very disappointed to say the least.
Just because you're not super busy doesn't mean you have to be sloppy about your work. 
We have been trying to visit one local eatery a week minimally to help. Won't be back to this one for quite some time if ever again.

Excellent service and finest craft cocktails in the nation according to several magazines. Award-winning Emine the bar manager is a joy to watch as she makes the famous Blueberry Yum Yum or the Field of Dreams and more. They also have a rare, for the region, and reasonable happy hour pricing and the best seafood anywhere. The restored Key West Style restaurant was designed by her brother and had beautiful views and a wrap around porch for watching the passersby and scenery.
Everything was exceptional to the tacos, dips and drinks. Service was excellent as well, we will definitely be back, our new favorite taco place by far

Didn't even get far enough to try the pizza. 

We wanted to check it out for the first time. My husband has a weird thing about hating picking up pizza...no idea why lol but delivery prices are outrageous in my opinion, lol. He found this place bc the delivery charge ADVERTISED as $2! Yes! We took a look at the menu and the prices weren't bad. We went with garlic knots and a pizza.

Then, we get to the checkout and there's nearly $6 worth of random charges?

Delivery was actually $2.05...which 5cents isn't a big deal BUT WHY? 

Then there's this random "support local fee" that doesn't say why it's there or if it's a standard rate or a %....why are you charging me to support you? So confused.

Next (yesss...sooo many hidden fees just to try a pizza) they charge you for a tip BEFORE you even get their service? 
We usually tip waitstaff 20% and drivers 10%... this was 15% ...for just walking to my door and idek if it was good?

This is a great spot to hang out for an afternoon. 

We did the moonshine tasting which was a steal. Favorites included the apple pie, java one, and pickles. 

We ended up grabbing some hot chicken and beers to watch some football games outside. Definitely a great place to chill!
Best sandwich in America. Sure the wait is long but it's always consistently worth it

Fantastic food. Probably my favorite place to get Mexican food. Service can be a little slow but understandable right now, and the food is worth it! The ambiance is great, outdoor area beautifully decorated

Completely unimpressed. After reading all of the great reviews I was excited to check it out. It's really not worth the money. I ordered the Yakisoba with beef and it's dry and tasteless, the teriyaki chicken was slightly better but the gyozas are charred on the bottoms yet soggy and unappealing. Will not be back or suggest it to anyone.

Just had another excellent meal at Mikes. I have so far tried about half the menu and Mike knows what he is doing.  I like his chili and have already had the gumbo about ten times. Also liked his fish and chips and of course the premium hot dogs. The name is little misleading- could be Mikes Cafe

Im not sure what has happened here. Brio used to be a decent place. We decided to stop by after a movie tonight.  The service was horrible and the food was worse.  Our waiter didn't write down our order, he came back a few minutes after we ordered and asked what we ordered!!!!   My husband asked for a dinner salad and it never came out.  As we ate our mediocre food, we sat among at least 6 empty un-bussed tables, which was very unappealing. There were plenty of employees standing around, doing nothing as one woman was bussing tables by herself.  So needless to say, we will not be returning.
Amazing food!!!! I'm from Chicago came to visit a buddy in St. Louis, came to Barg first time I had the lamb shank everyone needs to have that
Excellent pizza. Thin crust with tasty edge crust.  Tone of topings.  Really cool atmosphere

Whenever I am in Indianapolis, I make it a point to stop at Yats (any location) The food is consistently great, every single dish I've ever had. Just point at the board, whatever you get will be delicious.

East Nashville's best burger and beer garden.  The stroganoff is amazing but then again all of their burgers are.  The tots and fries are amazing and the beer selection is great!  Pharmacy is out go to.  Be sure to get a table outside in the spring and summer.

Was craving sesame balls and was glad to see they have them here.  We placed an order for delivery, me and 2 co-workers.  Everything was good except the sesame balls. They were fried way to long. They are supposed to be soft with penut paste in the middle. They were cooked so long,  the middle was cooked out and hollow. I called and ordered a replacement,  because they were $6, and the second order came just as over-cooked as the first.  Advice: Don't order the Sesame Balls. You could play pool with them.

Came for brunch, had the best Bloody Mary (spicy Nola) of my life (2 for one made them only $4!!! That's so cheap!). Our server Kate was so friendly and wonderfully attentive and the food was absolutely delicious. BF got the chicken nachos and they were so fresh, I got the hombre burger with a turkey patty and the sweet potato fries. YUM!!!

Do you know quality? Actually? Then you know to find it here....high quality meat and produce combined with top notch cocktails served by an amazing staff. Keep up the good work ladies and gents! Real recognize real. Don't pass it up.

We tried the Horseshoe Grill for a Friday dinner for our group of friends. It was busy, but we were able to get seated right away. They stated on their website that they don't take reservations for Friday dinner. There was only 5 of us this week - usually we have 8 or 10. The server came right away and took our drink order. Speaking of service - our service was excellent all during dinner ! Next, we ordered our dinner items, which didn't take too long to arrive. The food overall was in the average range - French dip sandwich didn't have much meat, pulled pork was not very flavorful, and the Italian beef sandwich had a lot of meat, but not that much flavor. Mac & cheese side was excellent ! We split the French dip, but the bill was still $25+ - I would categorize that on the expensive side for what we ordered. The decor was very western and rustic - I like the way the whole restaurant was laid out and decorated. I would score The Horseshoe Grill in the 3 range with some pluses and some minuses.

Oh man, what can I say.... Taco Bus, I MISSED YOU!!! WTH???!!! Where did you go??? I don't even remember how long it's been but it's been a hot minute! All I remember is googling to order from the downtown St. Pete location for a lunch pick up and finding out that it was closed and gone!!! I thought all local locations went away. I don't know what happened but I'm so happy to have Taco Bus back in my life!!! This is my second order in two days! My husband and I use to hit up the St. Pete location on the regular. The place was ALWAYS super busy. If there wasn't available seating then we took it to a grassy spot overlooking the water in North Shore. I haven't physically been to this location on Treasure Island beach but it looks like they upgraded to indoors but kept the bus. Although that eliminates Florida weather issues, I still miss the stationary food truck feel. It was a huge staple to the community. I'm still unsure and baffled as to why the location closed with how crazy busy they were everyday, but I'm super stoked that Uber Eats alerted this location to me!!! 

Now that I'm done gushing, I'm also pleased to say that Taco Bus has not once disappointed and there is like a decade+ of experience! Between me and hubs, stepson, nieces & nephews, great nephew... not one complaint except from my belly to my eyes saying "it's too much!". Their portion size has been and still is overwhelming in size! I'm a fanatic of their shrimp burrito and it's my go-to always. I struggle to

If you like pretension, you'll love this place. From the beginning, the interaction with the hostess felt forced and unnatural, almost unwelcoming. The club-like environment is fun for drinks, I would guess. The food, however, leaves a lot to be desired - which is clearly an afterthought to the décor. The menu sets the expectation of being on par with any prime steakhouse, but the execution is very poor. If you want to play dress up and sip martinis this place could be ok, maybe. If you're looking for a fun dinner spot, skip it. Restaurants and nightclubs set unique expectations and combining the experience in this fashion offers a watered down version of both.

We went there last night for dinner and have to say I was not impressed. I ordered the 2 meat combo, ribs n hot link with fries and cole slaw. I have to say first off the service was great. But that's it. I asked if the slaw was mayo or vinegar based and was told it was a combo. It was so runny I needed a spoon. Ribs? Where were they?  3 little ribs that were the end of the rack. No more than 2 to 3 inches long. Even the knife had a hard time cutting thru them. Little to no meat. Almost burned to perfection! Absolutely no flavor. Do they even use a rub? The hot link was so so. I get better ones at Costco. The Texas toast was horribly dry. Looked like it had been sitting for quite a while. No butter. I hope this was just a bad night for the chef

Ordinary food. Cold service. The waitress was extremely nice to the table beside us while completely ignoring our table. She came by asking if everything is ok 5 times to the other table while turned pretty cold to us for no reason.
The Fish Fry is great. I have been craving it since the quarantine started. Can't wait until they open again so I can have some of that delicious beer battered food of my people.

Just had some hot chicken for the first time and it was awesome!  If you are curious or new to "hot chicken" you can get huge tenders, quarter white or dark chicken and choose from either no flavor or plain (like fried chicken) or they have several levels of spice with a nice semi sweet kick or hot if you dare. You can also get chicken grilled same sauce options  
 Lots of "southern" sides to choose from like mashed potatoes or green beans with bacon or collard greens and Mac and cheese. You can also get fries or a healthy kale salad as a side or meal sized with chicken.  

They have a selection of cane sugar sodas on tap and for desert several pies on a jar to choose from.  

Dinner tonight was hot and fresh, they're open for eat in with socially distanced tables or drive thru and delivery services also were coming in picking up orders.  

Don't be a chicken and miss out on something new and delicious in Seminole City Center, you gotta try this!

Went there for dinner last night. It is the first time they have had the dining room open since this mess started. They are limiting occupancy and from what I can tell making it a safe environment for everybody. We have never been unhappy with the food or the service and that continued last night. We both had Prime Rib and it was cooked to perfection, the cut was trimmed so there was very little fat. The French onion soup was also very good. Our server Chas was prompt and thoughtful. The Keg really has done a remarkable job coming back from having the dining room closed for so long. 
Corbin Smith

4 for taste, 5 for social distancing/health and 3 for pricing

I love the bakery foods here - this location was closed earlier from the COVID pandemic. Prior to COVID hitting however, this place was nice and vibrant. I bought their snowbunny cake, which was a beautiful surprise for my mom's birthday. It was light, airy and creamy. It was expensive, but they provided candles, knife and a great packaging for the box. 

Tips/Takeaways: 
-Cakes are expensive but delicious, they package everything up for you nicely! Would recommend using their online order system to call the cake in and make for a quick pick-up

I was really excited for Hunter's Station to open, and was happy to see that it lived up to the hype! A food hall style space, with grilled cheeserie, picnic tap (bar and food), Vui's Kitchen (Vietnamese), Hugh Baby's (Burgers), Tacos aurora, and Citizen Kitchen with local vendor specials. The prices are reasonable and its a great place to gather with friends and family or on a night out alone! Citizen kitchen has a great selection of grab and go products and other local products. Don't miss out on Caity Pies!! For the summer time they have a great outdoor seating area and some yard games. Parking is available for free for one hour behind the building, street parking around can be challenging to find.

Just don't order from here on the weekends. I'm so disappointed right now. They over-salted everything and it tastes awful. So disappointed. I think the chef is better during the week... I'm leaving 4 stars cuz it's been awesome every time but today... I will be trying other places from now on tho.
Great food & coffee! Fast friendly service!! I was very happy with our spur of the moment stop.

I wouldve rated this location as a 1 star but our serve was nice and the food was great. But the hostess were not knowledgeable. I had to make a reservation online(which I did) then called to confirm over the phone. They said they didn't see my name on the reservation and it took the 3rd hostess to finally say that to come in at 7p. My husband and I showed up and guess what? My name was not found on their reservation list. The girls were very clueless and the restuarant manager stepped in and I was telling her what was happening, she interrupted me. Christina was very rude. As a manger she should have the greatest customer service and she was not being a great example for the "new" employees and the face of a huge food chain. I would hate to not be able to enjoy coming in since it is the only location we have here in Idaho. Overall, our first visit was not impressive.

Living in New Orleans I have always heard of this place but just always overlooked this place in the Bywater area. Well I been missing out for sometime now. The food was really great and so was the service. I had the biscuits and gravy and it was very very good. Will definitely be back more often now. Prices are very reasonable also.

I have been eating with Al-Tarboush since I was in my teens. It is difficult for me to buy grocery store hummus/tabouleh/babaganoush because once you've had Al-Tarboush-made food, it's hard to go back to anything else. Wonderful family-owned small business. When I come back to STL, Al-Tarboush is always one of my first stops.

First let me say I'm a hater. Hubby always wants to eat here...but I think its expensive, food not amazing and service is only average.

Hubby and I went on Tuesday and they had a BOGO special on snack or small size traditional wings (which i really like). We ordered those, a nacho and a side of cheese curds. Thry have redone their menu and im not in love w the new nachos (but i totally ate a bunch of them). For the wings we got 1/2 medium (fave) and trued something new -1/2 Asian Zing (likr thai chili). The wings were juicy, crisp and perfectly sauced. 

We ordered sour cream for the nachos and extra ranch for the wings and there was no charge on there (there usually is). While meal was about $35. I think i should go on BOGO night more!!

The service was attentive. Our server gave great recommendations. This was my best experience at a BWW and based on this I'll prob go back more.
Extremely nice and friendly staff! We stopped in and didn't know what to expect, and it's been a long time since I was so blown away by a restaurant. Great food and really cheap
Did pick up here on my way back to Philly service was really fast. My mom is still raving about the burger she got that was 4 months ago lol

The absolute best Chinese food in the city. I love this place. Everything on the menu is yummy and I order something different every time I'm there. Great for takeout but I prefer to eat in.  The service is fantastic too. A+

Ordered delivery for the Pho Ga My. It was DELICIOUS! I love the addition of the Bok Choy! The chicken itself has so much flavor and the broth was wonderful. Would LOVE to order Pho from this place again! Also: delivery includes a disposable set of chopsticks, a soup spoon (Pho spoon!), and a bowl to poor the broth over the noodles! That counts as a win!!
Good food. Good service. Clean restroom. Best Thai food on the south side of the city. Better than Thai Spice and House of Thai.
This place has gone waaaaaaaaaaay down hill. Our server at dim sum was incredibly rude, and everything just kept circulating.

Their food is pretty darn tasty and I've gone here quite a few times.  I enjoy the outside feeling and it does remind me of hanging out in Baja.  I rarely drink, but if I do drink, it's gotta be something delicious.  I had a taste of my husband's pomegranite margarita at Season's 52 that was exquisite, so while here, I decided to take them up on the free margarita Axxess deal.  I was disappointed in the margarita and pawned it off on my husband.  I will be back for their delicious brunch, but will skip the margarita.

I am sooo addicted to the TRUFFLED EGG TOAST -yummy!

Great selection of wines and cheeses as well!

This is a sports bar-right?  And the owner played in the NFL- right?  So.....why is it that when you come in here on a Sunday during NFL season no one seems to know what channels games are on, no one really cares to get them tuned in, they have Nat Geo and euro league soccer playing on most of the screens?
NOTE TO MANAGER- if 75% of your guests are wearing Colts gear- it MIGHT be smart to get the Colts game on those screens BEFORE the first series is over!
Cheap drinks and above average bar food are great- but not worth it if you can't watch games too.......
Solid Thai place!!! Thai ice tea is extremely sweet tho but good! I love their pineapple fried rice and green curry.

Never stop if your coming from out of town this place sucks for people that are taking home pizza. He said it was gonna be 45 minutes, I said but I'm taking it to go myself,they seemed not to care  not good.

Stayed here for a week during a conference. It sits centrally located to just about everything you want to be around down town. 

Upon arrival, you can clearly see that their drop off area is a difficult situation. There's not an area for you to pull in and drop off. You'll have to stop in the middle of the street if there's no room for you. Their parking fees are high as you would expect. 

The hotel lobby is lit dimly that brings out a richness to the atmosphere. A coffee shop/convenient store sits to the left of registration. Check-in was quick and easy in the morning. Staff was friendly and helpful. 

Upon arriving to my floor it was freezing. It seemed to be that way my whole stay. The air conditioning in my room though was no where near that cold even at 65 degrees oddly. My room came w/ a mini fridge, coffee maker along w/ the usual toiletries. However the soaps were by Aveda :)

Good internet connection. The elevators though, I feel only 2 of the 5 worked the whole time I was there. The hotel has a few bars to choose from, each just as great as the next. 

There is construction currently going on here, so if you're a sound sleeper, notify the front desk. You can thank me later.
The taste pallette here is always so bright and colorful.  I absolutely love this place.  Service is great everytime.   Delicious food.

All I can say is meh. We stopped here for a quick lunch and a drink. 

There was no posted draft menu so the waiter had to ramble the whole list to us. 

I ordered the Thai salad, it was alright. Nothing remarkable and the shrimp was clearly frozen at some point. My sister in law ordered the breakfast tacos and they were highly disappointing. The eggs had a weird fake consistency and no flavor. There was basically no bacon as advertised. Too much fake egg and no other substance. Not good. 

Our server was ok, forgot a drink twice though. And we watched a table get seated and ask for a server twice, and they still didn't have one when we left l. 

I feel like this place is best known for brunch drinks and crazy over the top sandwiches. So go, but don't expect much.

Stopped in while traveling thru... food was excellent and in taste and presentation.  Service a tad bit laid back in not in any hurry to serve but still good. Wouldn't mind to come back and try other foods.
Great food great hash browns Joe scramble ,add cheese, was awesome. Service was excellent they checked in like 20 times and paid extra attention to my elderly parents!
Beautiful family owned restaurant with a genuine heart. We love their steak tacos and their home made salsa. I can't even believe they make their own bake goods too. Very friendly.

I love Bevi's the Soft shell Crab Po-Boy Rocks !! The atMosphere is quaint. Food excellent. Everything is great the crawfish are divine. When my son flies in from NY the absolute first request is for Bevi's shrimp PO Boy..staff are friendly and the place is spotless.
Definitely a little pricey but worth it for the quality + taste. Everything I've tried has been delicious! The woman who owns is also super sweet.

I've dined at the Buddakan in New York a few times and it's truly one of my top 5 restaurants. I felt compelled to leave another review for the Buddakan in Philadelphia because it was just that good. The food was somewhat "tastier" than the NY location. The serve was also great. I started off with the general tso dumplings of course and they were to die for. I had the snapper and it melted in mouth. 
This location is smaller than the NY location but it packed a punch. The food was exceptionally good here. 

Will return the next time i am in Philly

Can't say enough good things! I've loved everything I have tried. I didn't even realize everything was gluten free until maybe my third time there. I'm not a coffee person so I can't speak to that, but the food is delicious. We have ordered a cake from there for our gluten free birthday girl and it was fabulous! They even wrote on the cake for us. Will come back again and again.

Had a wonderful experience.  The food was excellent and enjoyed by all in our group.  We were well cared for by Denise. She is awesome!!  It got pretty busy while we were there, since it was a Sunday morning, but they handled it well.  The manager checked-in with us to make sure everything was good, which I always think is a nice touch.  Will return soon!!

Our food was delicious (we had blackened chicken pasta and steak) and our server Maria was wonderful.  She had nice recommendations, friendly, fun and made our dinner a pleasant experience.  We are locals and will be back.

Food was ok. The steak guy was rude!  He gave me a small piece of overcooked steak so I asked him for another piece. He grabbed the steak off my plate and gave me a piece that was almost raw. Will not go back. Very disappointed!

Favorite place to get a slice of cake from their to-go service counter! Addicted to the lemon cake. 

When I dine in, love the biscuits and have enjoyed their brunch options in general. Love the atmosphere and staff is always super upbeat and helpful.

Ordered some egg and chorizo tacos to go which were very tasty. The side with the meal however of white rice and black beans needed more seasoning, which honestly surprised me as this is a Latin restaurant. 

I ordered a mimosa as well and enjoyed my meal at the tables outside with a friend.

I've been to a lot of pizza places, but this one is definitely at the top of my list. I ordered a half and half pizza with pepperoni and "Get Lift'd" which is chicken, spinach, and mushrooms. The pizza was great. Very friendly service, with a comfortable, welcoming atmosphere. I highly recommend trying it out.

This is my favorite Nashville restaurant and I'm a native. You go in and you feel like you've left your world no matter what it's like. The staff is fun friendly creative, the atmosphere is chic. Be sure to check out the upstairs and the outside area as well. It's American gourmet menu that has a creative twist to labeling their food items it's enough to get you going. Chef 'Brian is joyful and does naturally in the kitchen what many of us strive to do. He cooks and shares a part of himself.

Mikey, the manager and other co-owner besides Brian, has more energy than I do and always has a big smile on his face. He's very conscientious to make sure everybody has a great time and experience. The upstairs is great to book for small groups. The downstairs is cozy comfortable nicely decorated and easy to check out to see who's there. Located in North Gulch it's accessible easily from Broadway or Charlotte. See you there!
Went there for pickup yesterday. Friendly staff and food was ready right when we got to the drive-thru window. We will be back!

Our first time here and it was amazing.  People working here lives their job and what they do.  The food preparation rivals much more expensive restaurants and the taste is a mixture of originality with innovation.   We are so glad we came and we will certainly be back again.  Our server was helpful hospitable and made our dinner pleasant.  Lots of people when we came but the service was very fast.  We need more restaurant like this.

2nd time here trying to give it a second chance. I wish I could write a raving review as I've seen on this site but not so much.  You go to a restaurant for an experience especially with margaritas. Order a Margarita with a top shelf tequila and received it in a plastic cup.  Anyway, collected our bill and peace out. Never again!

We opted to try this restaurant after we were unable to get seats in 2 other nearby restaurants.  And as with unexpected twists, this turned out to be a great choice so much so we will be back to have their Uni sushi.

Their gyoza and oyster agemono were excellent though they were served later than the sushi we ordered.  

Their specialisation is the hand rolled sushi with surprisingly good combination of flavour and texture.  We liked their lava roll.  

We also had nigiri sushi with the amai ebi (sweet shrimp) as worthy.  It was freshly peeled in front of us.  The escolar Fish was also very tasty.

We will be back.

This place has it all ! From food to service ! As a business owner I look at details.. I look for everything and I'm very judgmental and not easily impressed.. but this place was nice !! I loved the churrasco argentino .. the service was very nice too .. our server was friendly and knew the menu very well. I will be coming back for more or the churrasco.. my spouse loved his bandeja paisa too..

My wife went to this location and ordered 2 McDoubles no cheese only onion and when she got the food the burgers had cheese. She explained she didn't want cheese and was scolded that it should be ordered as double hamburgers, this is fine but when she got home and I opened the burgers they had put so much onion on the burgers the buns were dripping wet and after emptying some on the onion I had a pile of onion larger than the burger itself. This is completely unacceptable, I am writing a formal complaint and sending pictures of the dripping bun and onion pile.

Overall, this was a good Dominican spot. The service was really friendly and the servers were happy to help answer any questions about the menu. We tried the ox tail, stewed goat, chicken mofongo, plantains, and their beans and rice. Everything was pretty flavorful; my only gripe was that the goat was very salty, to the point where it was pretty hard to finish. Food was also luke warm but I think it because we were near to closing time. French fries are bangin'. Their smoothie was made with fresh mango which was really solid.

Our visit to Superior Seafood was the answer to the post-museum hunger blues one Saturday.  My husband wanted oysters so this is where we ended up.  It is located in a prime corner lot and the inside is full of rich, dark woods and large windows looking out onto St. Charles Avenue.  I loved the ambiance of the place.  

The menu was well balanced and our waitress, Ivy, was helpful when it came to ordering.  She recommended the frozen pomegranate mojito for me and it was delicious.  The pomegranate flavor was subtle, but well balanced with the mint.  My husband tried the Urban South "Shuck Cancer" oyster stout.  He had 3 glasses if that is any indicator of how good it is! 

We moved on to a dozen raw oysters and Ivy's recommendation of the beet and arugula salad.  The oysters were incredibly fresh and tasty and came with all the fixings.  The salad was delicious.  I do not like beets normally, but they were roasted well and accompanied by a balsamic vinaigrette and goat cheese.  Lastly, we ordered the shrimps and grits.  The sauce was a cream sauce with tasso inside.  It was a tad salty, but the large, well-cooked shrimp made up for the slight saltiness.  The shrimp and grits are a very rich, decadent dish so keep that in mind if you order it.  

Additionally, I would like to address some of the bad reviews for this restaurant.  Your waiter/waitress is a resource that you should utilize.  Ours told us what she liked, as well as what she would not recommend.  Use your resources
Amazing food! Their burrito was huge & will definitely fill you up. No need for an appetizer. I've tried various items & none have disappointed. This is my favorite place so far.

The biggest disappointment I've had in over 10 years ! If I could give a minus 1 rating - I would !!! I ordered grilled chicken with baked mushrooms and baked peppers ! It was disgusting !!! The mushrooms and the peppers there from the can !!!!! We are in the middle of the summer and they are charging almost $10 for this sad , dry and sour palate of disgust !!! Wow !!! If you call yourself a restaurant with this kind of food you should just close right now . The pita bread was stale and smelled like old cooking oil !! All of my coworkers where shocked to see this dish !!

Sitar India was suggested on yelp for me and I'm so glad it was. After reading through the comments I felt it might give our regular Indian buffet places (Ekta and New Delhi) a run for their money. We didn't love the location, there wasnt much parking and there was trash on the stairs. We were seated immediately, brought a pitcher of water and invited to partake in the buffet. Yaaasss to the food. The food offered at this buffet seemed so much fresher than other Indian buffets. The vegetables in each dish were still distinct and not over cooked. You could really taste the individual ingredients in each of the dishes. The spices and curries themselves did not overpower the flavors of food but simply added to the dishes' overall deliciousness. We tried everything that was offered with the exception of the 2 rice offerings. The meat dishes were not dry- which was very refreshing. Even the chai tea was more flavorful than Ektas. The salad bar portion was fresh and offered a delicious mango cutney! I will say the only thing that was better elsewhere was the naan. It was a bit tough, flavorless and overcooked. Also, we happened to attend during Diwali, a Hindu holiday and there were special desserts offered which was really nice. I was grateful to have been a part of their celebration in that way.

I normally would dine in at another local Mediterranean restaurant, but decided to give this place a chance in hopes of finding a great place that is closer for take out. This was a great
find! The food is very fresh and delicious and at a reasonable price. I will be getting food from here many more times in the future.

First important things to know - BYOB and cash only! There's is a little liquor store right across the street though which is super convenient. Also this place is pretty small and gets pretty busy even on week nights so I would highly recommend making a reservation (on resy). Now the food - we started with the hummus and the mussels. These both were amazing. Highly recommend. Next time I come back I would probably just stick to the smaller plates. The hummus was super fresh and the mussels were cooked perfectly. The sauce they came in was excellent. I ended up dipping the bread they gave the table in the sauce from the mussels. The larger plates we order - swordfish kabob and spicy shrimp pasta were good but the smaller plates were definitely better. The "spicy" shrimp pasta was good. I was just disappointed that it wasn't spicy at all. They really need to rename the dish on the menu. The larger plates are very generous portions. Definitely too full for dessert but I plan to be back again.

I ordered through Grubhub, they followed through great with the instructions I included. The cilantro didn't seem all that fresh but the noodles alone had a nice chewy and soft texture. Im visiting from New York City and decided to try Philly's pho but was let down by the broth. I strongly feel like the broth makes up 75% of the pho alone. The broth wasn't as flavorful as it is at the spot I go to in NYC in elmhurst which I highly recommend (it's called pho bac, in case anyone reading is visiting NYC). Im glad I asked for extra noodles ($2 extra) because I loved them. I ordered pho chin which is just vermicelli noodles with cooked brisket. Overall, Im more open to trying another pho spot in Philly.

Schlafly is a lovely brewery/restaurant with attention to their beer. Not only do they give you tons of information about your beer for the tasting, but there's a cute in-restaurant store for take home beers. Plus, the food is delicious! We loved it here.

PROS:
-Private parking lot for DDs. Fantastic if you just wanna get lunch/dinner without drinking too. It's a decently spacious parking lot and reserved for customers of the brewery only. 
-Service was fantastic. Our waitress kept our water glasses topped off nicely, checked in often, and our food was out way faster than expected. She was really patient when we couldn't figure out our beer choices, and she was generally super friendly. 
-Food menu is decently unique and varied. I can't say I've seen a beer cheese soup before, but I was met with one here. And it was freakin' delicious! Portion sizes are large, and my tablemate and I were really impressed with every item of food we ordered. It's exactly as ordered - only way better than expected. It was a fantastic dinner. 
-Love some of their beer choices? This location has a small "take it home" shop available right in front! Take most of their beer home with you in your choice of container - bottles, cans, growlers, crowlers. Not all of their beer was available in every type, but it was most of their selection that was an option. Easy for all of us, they include what containers each beer is available for "take home" purchase within the beer details booklet at your table du

Daily bagel is such a hidden little gem in Reno. The employees are so kind and I've never had a problem with my order. The bacon cheddar is by far my favorite bagel, but you have to go early to get it because it sells out fast! Seriously the best bagels in Reno, their sandwiches are the best too!
Went here on a whim and was very happy with the food.  I am looking forward to the dining in when it opens up.   It is a great place, don't let the outside fool you.  Will go back

I really hate to update with anything negative in today's atmosphere, but bad is bad and it doesn't deserve a pass.  We ordered a pizza and some mozzarella sticks from Mama's for pick up last week.  I was just that desperate for pizza, and wanting to support the closest local restaurant to us.  We got there about five minutes before they said it was ready.  It was done promptly in their quoted time.

We live a mere five minutes away, and I was starving so I dug right in.  But...wait.  The cheese was all congealed and had a dull luster look to it.  Why?  Because it was ICE COLD.  They gave us a pizza they cooked probably many hours earlier and just had sitting around.  What a disgrace to serve to your community at times like these.  We had to put it back in the oven to resurrect it, and it was just as flavorless as I remembered Mama's being.  The mozzarella sticks were hot, at least.  Not the side sauce, though.

I will give them credit for being able to put the food into my car for a contactless pick up (which is why I generously gave them 2 stars vs 1 star).  But they wouldn't take payment over the phone so you're stuck using Eatstreet, who charges fees, if you want to go 100% contactless.  Silly.

I'm never giving Mama's my money again.  Ice cold pizza.  Why even quote me a time?  Tell me you have a stale one all ready for pick up ASAP.  I'll sooner go to McDonald's.

EASILY one of our favorite restaurants in NOLA!  Oh goodness the Bacos are just perfect.  

My usual:
1 bbq pork baco
2 crispy spicy brisket bacos
Steamed Potstickers with char pork salad.

I would love to try something else BUT I can't go and not get the above items!!!  So So So good!  

Now I'm hungry!  LOL

Tonight was just ok. 

First time coming, and I liked the vibe. Our server, Jasmine, was beyond amazing. Drinks were great! Only thing was the POS was down and it was cash only. There was a small sign at the front, but it was inconsequential. Some in our party only had cards...and they eventually, "abrocadabra" got it to work out.

I did appreciate that you could smoke on the patio and they have a small cigar humidor that you can get a nice smoke with friends. I hope my next visit is much better.

Definitely do NOT order online. I placed an order at 545p and it's 642p and they do not have it ready and couldn't track it down.  If you are going to order, use Grubhub. Still waiting. At least the food is decent...
Was heisitiant to order take out from such a high end eatery... so glad we did! 10/10 in quality and presentation. Will definitely be back!!

Waited 8 minutes before host/server noticed us. Restaurant was empty other than 2 guests at the bar. There were only two of us we asked to sit at the bar and she said she'd have to check if seating was available. She sat a party of 10 and 3 minutes later came back and said it would be a 15 minute wait.... 

The place was empty.... seats everywhere.

I've always loved the food here and that did not disappoint. What did was the interior is in need of a refresh. The wait to get in was over 45 minutes which isn't bad for a Saturday night, though the lack of benches to wait was. All in all I would go back but not anytime soon.
Amazing service and sushi I have eaten sushi all my life and this is for sure top 3 family owned don't pass this place up

*Take out review*

This was my second time getting take out from Dan Dan; delivery the first time and picked it up this go around. I was completely blown away by the size and beautiful decor of this restaurant. I can't wait to dine in some day soon.

But for the important part - the food. My buddy wanted "noodles" for the Eagle's game on Thursday, and I knew just the place. I ordered the Dan Dan noodles for both of us (this was my second go around with these. I hardly order the same thing off a menu twice, but I've had dreams about Dan Dan noodles since.) Soft and chewy noodles cooked perfectly in a nutty, spicy sauce whose heat builds on you. The best part - they're once of those foods that tastes even better the next day because the noodles absorb more of the chili oil and sauce. 

We also got the pepper chicken (AKA Szechuan chicken. One of my favorite dishes of that area in Asia. Such a subtle, building heat the sets your mouth on fire deceivingly while giving you a warm, euphoric feeling). We ordered both the wantons and dumplings in chili oil - both were fantastic. 

Check out Dan Dan. Order the Dan Dan. I can't wait til the next time I dine in at Dan Dan.

Update: They are opened for take only.  The process is much improved from a couple weeks ago. Now they have masks and gloves, enforce social distancing from/to the customers. If your order is not ready, they will bring it out to your car.  Food and service are still excellent.
SNAP PIZZA IS 1Mx BETTER THAN &pizza. Snap literally is vetri pizza quality, it's the bomb. No other custom pizzas compare
Been here multiple times. Everything I have tried has been amazing. The atmosphere is fun and makes you feel like you have been taken to New Orleans.  I recommend this place to everyone

Made my way from Old Northeast in St Pete to Ronnies because I desperately wanted a good Reuben. 
 Was worth the trip. I'm sure that I will go back. 
The girl behind the counter said that she would recommend the macaroni salad. I would to now that I have had it. 
 A bit of a journey but sometimes you have to go where you have to to get what you want. 
  Was grilled , stacked and tasted excellent. Worth the trip
Read mixed reviews when it first opened. People are inpatient with new places opening up. Went and tried it. Good pizza. Friendly folks. Would definitely go again.

Stopped here for lunch with my wife. This place was pretty dang good. Kind of like the Chipotle approach, where you choose want you want and add toppings. They have warm chips if you order more than 1 taco. They have a full bar! This place is pretty dang good!
Ordered food here a couple years ago. Great restaurant. Bartending staff was awesome. We really liked their late hours and real welcoming atmosphere. Kristen was always great.

Watched the entire crew make food without gloves. If 0 stars was possible I would be rating that. Asked for gloves for my meal due to an allergy, saw "chef" make my own food without them. Saw blonde server pick up containers from the floor and begin fixing a salad with her bare hands. Left before they could bring the food out. It's absolutely disgusting. Covid or not, cross-contamination and food poisoning is no joke. Pro tip: don't blatantly ignore requests of people that can see into the kitchen.

Oh my gosh.  Amazing.  Thank you Alyonka for staying open during these tough times.  We ordered all 3 main courses and all the desserts thinking we would make them last over a few meals.  Instead we greedily ate most everything in one sitting.  Comfort food.  Fresh food. Delicious food.  Family owned. Made with love and you can taste it.   Also, with your take out you get a free soup to share with a neighbor or someone in need, which we did and it was gratefully received.

Unbelievable blackened redfish! They have a few different options on Blackened Redfish! The Redfish Tchopatoulas is the one I had! Served with a crawfish cornbread dressing and collard greens! It was also topped with sautéed shrimp and a lemon-butter sauce! Really good and huge portion! Well worth it!

Hands down, one of the best steakhouses out there. If I was an alien in space, I would have a meal here then conquer earth after. 

Made no reservation prior to a visit of two in the middle of the week, an hour after opening and the place was PACKED, so first tip, make a reservation. Anyway, we were offered a table and informed prior that if an 1hr30min should be enough, and we accepted. The service was exceptional, the atmosphere was amazing, classy, cozy, no need to overdress, just don't come too causal with sweatpants or shorts or flip flops. 

The food was hats off, a 5 star tasting luxury with large portions. Fresh enough, flavorful enough, cooked enough, and overall enjoyable and decently/causally presented. The cocktail shrimp is a must, the steaks were perfectly cooked, and the mashed potatoes were oh Lardy lord. Good. The soups were some beans with the food or upgrade to the Lobster one, which you should. Complimentary made in the house bread variety and it wasn't expensive. (2 steaks w/2 sides, 2 soups, shrimp cocktail 4 jumbo pieces, complementary bread, 2 berates, for $130) 

This place is perfect for friends, business, family, dates, wedding or a just a hungry man or woman who would like a good meal. Parking is available in the street or easier in the garage right across for 3 dollars for two hours. Enjoy and you must try this out when coming to Indianapolis

So I heard the commercial on the radio for the new Pub Burger and I figured I would stop in and give it a try.  Well let me tell you it is FRIGGIN delicious, I substituted for a plain butter bun and got cheese curds as the side (of course)instead of fries.  The before and after pictures pretty much speak for themselves so I'm not sure why I even wrote a review at all... LOL.

**Disclaimer: I have never been to China**
Im not sure how this restaurant qualifies as Chinese food. There is no way I'm buying the fact that this is in any way flavors or techniques of Chinese cuisine. The flavors made me think of the midwest, flat, dull, and uninspiring. In fact, if I were to guess where the recipes came from I would go with Archbold, Ohio the home of La Choy American "Chinese" Food. In addition to that straight from the jar taste, the steamed vegetables were cold and the mushrooms were not fully rehydrated and were rubbery. On a positive note, the root beer was good.

Five Disappointments

Let's face it. 2020 has been a terrible year. Any amount of normalcy I can find is definitely welcomed. So when I took that first step onto Stearns Wharf I was transported to my childhood in San Diego and all was good again.

Stearns Wharf has been a Santa Barbara staple since 1872 (!!!). It's survived time, weather and even fires! You can drive your car on it and park here if you want. I walked it and I'm 1000% sure it's totally safe but hearing those cars roll out on the wood....I'd have been nervous lol. There are 141 parking spots and the first 90 minutes is free before hitting $2.50/hour with a maximum fee of $20. Extremely reasonable IMO. 

On the pier itself you can fish, shop, eat and watch what's happening on the water. There's also the Sea Center (aquarium) which unfortunately you can't go inside during these times of COVID. That said, the cool breeze, smell of the sea, beautiful scenery and the total history where you're standing on are well worth your time. Highly recommended!

In the mood for lobster.  Stumble into this place.   Perfect detour.   Perfect place.   The seafood is fresh out of the lobster tank.   The lobster roll was really good.  The fried shrimp.  Out of this world.  I don't even like shrimp that much, theirs are delicious.   Absolutely recommend this place.

We got a salmon family bundle for yelp's big night in.  What an amazing treat!  It came with a bread, a salad, side and dessert.  The dip for the bread was yummy per usual.  I asked for 2 half salads because my house is divided on house or Caesar.  The salmon and potatoes were good and kept really well for carry out.  The cookies were warm and soft.  The hubs got an extra side the bacon Mac and Cheese.  He loved it.  We did curbside and the staff was very polite when I called and picked up.
